trigger_condition: The tool is called with an invalid/missing user_id or the user is not a workspace member, so the WorkspaceMembership query returns None.
guard_snippet: membership = (await session.execute(select(WorkspaceMembership).where(...))).scalars().first(); if membership and not (membership.is_owner or (membership.role and "web_builder:create" in (membership.role.permissions or []))): return ...
potential_consequence: A missing membership is not denied; the tool proceeds to WebBuilderService.generate_project and can create apps in the workspace without authorization.

trigger_condition: prompt is 1-2 characters long (failing WebAppBuildInput min_length=3) or other Pydantic validation fails when constructing WebAppBuildInput.
guard_snippet: if not prompt or not prompt.strip(): ...; if len(prompt) > app_config.WEB_BUILDER_MAX_PROMPT_CHARS: ...; build_input = WebAppBuildInput(...)
potential_consequence: A short prompt bypasses the tool's checks and raises inside WebAppBuildInput(...); the outer except Exception returns app_id="" and status="error" instead of a clean validation_failed response.

trigger_condition: Global WEB_BUILDER_ENABLED is true, but the workspace row has web_builder_enabled=False.
guard_snippet: def check_web_builder_enabled(): if not config.WEB_BUILDER_ENABLED: raise HTTPException(403, ...); await require_workspace_member(session, auth, payload.workspace_id)
potential_consequence: Workspace-level feature gating is bypassed; users in a workspace with web builder disabled can still generate, list, preview, and publish apps via the REST API.

trigger_condition: WorkspaceApp.storage_path is None (e.g. failed generation or legacy row) and /api/v1/web-builder/apps/{app_id}/preview is requested.
guard_snippet: if app_entity.storage_path: project_dir = Path(app_entity.storage_path); if not project_dir.is_absolute(): project_dir = Path(FILE_STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH).resolve() / "web-app" / ... (no else fallback)
potential_consequence: project_dir is never assigned, causing UnboundLocalError at 'if not project_dir.exists()' and a 500 instead of a 404 or fallback preview.

trigger_condition: A custom-domain request is made for a non-existent app or for an app that does not belong to payload.workspace_id.
guard_snippet: result = await deploy_service.verify_and_bind_custom_domain(...); if result.status == "failed": raise HTTPException(...); inside deploy_service: if app_entity: ... (no else branch)
potential_consequence: The service returns CustomDomainOutput(status="active", ...) when the WorkspaceApp is not found; the route returns 200, appearing to bind a domain to nothing.

trigger_condition: app_entity.storage_path is a relative path or symlink, or payload.file_path contains '..' after resolution.
guard_snippet: project_dir = Path(app_entity.storage_path); target_file = (project_dir / payload.file_path).resolve(); try: target_file.relative_to(project_dir) except ValueError: raise HTTPException(400, ...)
potential_consequence: project_dir is not resolved/fallback to FILE_STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH, so the mark tool may read/write relative to the process CWD and can miss path-traversal when project_dir itself is outside the configured storage root.

trigger_condition: A generated/disambiguated slug reaches 64+ characters and the last characters are the numeric disambiguation suffix or a trailing hyphen.
guard_snippet: sanitized_slug = (re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9-]", "-", final_slug.strip().lower()).strip("-") or "app"); sanitized_slug = sanitized_slug[:63].strip("-") or "app"
potential_consequence: [:63].strip("-") can remove the disambiguation suffix, producing a slug that already exists and causing the new static snapshot to overwrite the existing published app.

trigger_condition: custom_domain contains 'https://', a path, an IP, or any unvalidated string, or app_entity is None.
guard_snippet: clean_domain = custom_domain.strip().lower(); ... if app_entity: app_entity.custom_domain = clean_domain; app_entity.custom_domain_status = "active"
potential_consequence: Invalid/malformed custom domains are persisted as 'active' with no CNAME or ownership verification, and the function still returns success when the app is missing.

trigger_condition: A refinement request (build_input.app_id) targets an existing WorkspaceApp whose storage_path is None.
guard_snippet: if existing_app and existing_app.storage_path: ... else: app_id = str(uuid.uuid4()); workspace_dir = self.storage_base_path / "web-app" / ...; if existing_app: existing_app.preview_url = preview_url
potential_consequence: A new project directory is created under a new random app_id, but the original WorkspaceApp row is updated to point storage_path and preview_url at that new directory while keeping the old id, breaking the relationship between the app's id and its on-disk path.

trigger_condition: The streaming endpoint is called with app_id to refine an existing app, or HOSTING_BASE_DOMAIN is not 'apps.nowing.net'.
guard_snippet: app_id = str(uuid.uuid4()) (ignores build_input.app_id); public_url: f"https://{app_slug}.apps.nowing.net"
potential_consequence: Streaming cannot refine existing apps and reports a public URL on a hard-coded domain that may not match the configured HOSTING_BASE_DOMAIN.

trigger_condition: A provider rate-limit causes reroute_to_next_auto_pin and _merge_registry_agent_config while the thread is in a chat mode with a restricted enabled_tools list (e.g. web_builder).
guard_snippet: Main flow: if chat_mode.enabled_tools is not None: effective_enabled_tools = list(chat_mode.enabled_tools). Recovery path: (_) = await _merge_registry_agent_config(...) without re-applying chat_mode.enabled_tools.
potential_consequence: After recovery, the agent is rebuilt with the registry's full tool list, so a web-builder conversation could invoke tools other than build_web_app.

trigger_condition: A follow-up turn sends platform_metadata: {} while the thread already has non-empty mode metadata.
guard_snippet: thread_metadata = getattr(chat_thread, "platform_metadata", None); if platform_metadata is not None: chat_thread.platform_metadata = platform_metadata; elif thread_metadata is not None: platform_metadata = thread_metadata
potential_consequence: An empty dict overwrites the existing chat mode, causing resolve_chat_mode to fall back to 'default' and lose the web-builder/presentation context.

trigger_condition: platform_metadata contains a mode flag with a truthy non-boolean value, such as 'web_builder_mode': 'false' or '0'.
guard_snippet: for mode in CHAT_MODES.values(): if mode.mode_id == "default": continue; if metadata.get(mode.flag_key): return mode
potential_consequence: String values like 'false' or '0' are interpreted as enabled, activating the wrong chat mode.

trigger_condition: The workspace id does not exist and a mode with only a global flag (presentation_studio or meeting_minutes) is requested.
guard_snippet: if mode.workspace_feature_field: if workspace is None: return False; ...; return True
potential_consequence: The mode is allowed because the global flag is checked but the workspace is not, so the stream may continue referencing a non-existent workspace.

trigger_condition: A published app has a configured custom_domain and the visitor's Host header matches that custom domain.
guard_snippet: if base_domain and not host_clean.endswith(f".{base_domain}"): raise HTTPException(400, "Malformed host domain")
potential_consequence: The custom domain request is rejected with 400; only *.HOSTING_BASE_DOMAIN hosts are served, so custom-domain apps are unreachable.

trigger_condition: A visitor navigates to the bare published domain, e.g. https://slug.apps.nowing.net/.
guard_snippet: @host_router.get("/web-apps/host", response_class=HTMLResponse); router.include_router(web_builder_host_router)
potential_consequence: FastAPI has no host= mount and the handler is at /web-apps/host, so root-path requests to the published domain return 404 unless an external layer rewrites the URL.

trigger_condition: LLM or user supplies an app_name, slug, or language longer than the corresponding WorkspaceApp column (name 255, slug 100, language 10).
guard_snippet: name = Column(String(255), nullable=False), slug = Column(String(100), nullable=False), language = Column(String(10), nullable=False); Pydantic fields use Field(...) / Field(default="en") with no max_length.
potential_consequence: Pydantic accepts oversized values; the DB insert may fail or truncate, producing a record that does not match the returned WebAppBuildOutput and possibly raising an unhandled 500.

trigger_condition: The environment lacks /app and FILE_STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH / WEB_BUILDER_PUBLIC_APPS_PATH are not set absolutely; the web server and workers run from different working directories.
guard_snippet: FILE_STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH = os.getenv(..., "/app/.local_object_store" if os.path.exists("/app") else "./.local_object_store"); public_apps_base = Path(app_config.WEB_BUILDER_PUBLIC_APPS_PATH).resolve()
potential_consequence: Path(...).resolve() yields different absolute paths depending on the process CWD, so a Celery worker may write snapshots where the web server cannot find them, returning 404 for published apps.

trigger_condition: A generated or published app references or loads external HTTPS resources.
guard_snippet: WEB_BUILDER_CSP = ("default-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https:; img-src 'self' data: https: blob:; font-src 'self' data: https:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https: https://fonts.googleapis.com; connect-src 'self' https:; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' https://cdn.tailwindcss.com https://unpkg.com;")
potential_consequence: The CSP allows arbitrary HTTPS origins for default/image/font/connect sources and permits unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval scripts, so generated apps can load third-party scripts and exfiltrate data; per-app allow-lists are noted as future work.

trigger_condition: LLM/user code contains '</script >', '< /script>', 'document["cookie"]', 'window.document.cookie', 'import("https://...")', 'require(...)', or 'export default function() {}'.
guard_snippet: re.sub(r"</script>", ...); re.sub(r"\bdocument\.cookie\b", ...); re.sub(r"\blocalStorage\b", ...); re.sub(r"import\s+[^;]+;?", "", code)
potential_consequence: The regex-based sanitizer can be bypassed, allowing script tag injection, cookie/localStorage access, and remote code loading in preview/published HTML.
